tools.name: apix402_catalog
tools.description: List every apix402 check an agent can buy: route, price in USDC, what question it answers, and its free preview. Start here. Payment is x402 over plain HTTP -- no API key, no account, the wallet is the identity.

tools.name: dao_governance_discrepancies
tools.description: Live sample: DAO governance proposals closest to their deadline, with a count of disagreements between the off-chain Snapshot signal and a direct read of the onchain Governor contract. Fixed set of tracked DAOs, no arguments. The count is free; which DAO disagrees and how is the paid GET /dao-propos

tools.name: oracle_staleness_sample
tools.description: Live sample: for a fixed set of price feeds, whether each one would be rejected right now by a guard built on that feed's own measured cadence. Boolean verdicts only; ages, thresholds, the Chainlink-vs-Pyth spread and the revert selector are the paid GET /oracle-staleness.

tools.name: lending_depeg_sample
tools.description: Live sample: one fixed, real Aave V3 position -- whether it is exposed to the stETH depeg blind spot and how much of its collateral is wstETH. The depeg level at which it becomes liquidatable is the paid GET /lending-depeg-exposure, which takes any borrower.

tools.name: vesting_status_sample
tools.description: Live sample: the current state of one fixed vesting plan read straight from the contract. The paid GET /vesting-status takes any Hedgey plan or Sablier stream.

tools.name: safe_authority_sample
tools.description: Live sample: who can actually move funds out of one fixed Gnosis Safe -- owners, threshold, and modules expanded recursively, because a Safe that reads as 1-of-1 can in fact be governed through a module by a separate 2-of-8.
